dayLines:
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Leaf litter, birdcall, the smell of rot becoming soil. The woods, being the woods.
Movement — a snowshoe hare, white in winter and brown in summer, huge hind feet.
👁 Skittish — it bolts at a shadow. Come in slow, or run it down.
Some of these unknown nuts are starting to look familiar — sort them at camp in good light and the name might come to you.
Unfamiliar unknown nuts — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Unfamiliar unknown berries — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
A sturdy stick (crafting material).
Journal: Deep shade. The floor keeps its secrets.
Journal updated: a tree with compound leaves and hard nuts grows here too — better than a tree with lobed leaves and oval nuts in scaly caps.

A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 4× unknown nuts, 4× unknown nuts, 5× unknown berries. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.

Salvador leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you. Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you: Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📓 Journal: Counter: Stand tall and shout — When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched.
📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
You've learned Old World Caches — it carries Eagle Eye.

Travel 1 tile to creek.
— Moving water —
Cold, clear, moving. The best thing you've seen all day.
✅ You saw the creek. Sari nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
You make for the creek to drink before night.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
You come home after 2 days. The smell of the cookfire does something to your chest you don't examine. "You're thinner," someone says. "You're still here," you say.
3 unprocessed hauls onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
